editorial.where: Canopy reference products and imagery that spans dates
editorial.finding: The heading grants reference-product status that the body does not establish. The later disclosure explicitly acknowledges that no use was recorded supporting that status.
The claim that nothing was read from an abstract conflicts with the supplied Kaiser p.1 block, which is explicitly labeled Abstract and supplies two citations.

Claims about the search history, exclusive sourcing from the workstream brief, and absence of any Edmonds accuracy measurement from the knowledge base are not established by the supplied citations. The excerpts cannot verify those broader sourcing and absence claims.

editorial.where: Expectations not supported — Kaiser CONTRADICTED entry
editorial.finding: The disclosure presents the losses as contradicting the expected outperformance but omits the same p.9 block's result that OSM-label training beats baseline Ia by 1.5 percentage points. That block reports a win against a smaller accurate-label baseline alongside losses against other baselines, so the unqualified contradiction is misleading.

The recorded hunt statuses, counts of verified uses, and claims of repeated full-text searches are not backed by the supplied citations or ledger evidence. In particular, the Benedek excerpt establishes challenges across dates, not that nothing ingested confirms or refutes the expected method capability.
